description: This file defines an Angular component called ViewerTransactionsComponent, which renders a UI for viewing and filtering transaction logs. It includes various filters (by TX ID, VSYNC ID, PID, UID, Type, Layer/Display ID, and search text) and displays transaction entries in a virtual scroll viewport. It also handles interaction events such as filter changes and entry clicks, and passes data via an input property UiData.

classes.name: ViewerTransactionsComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying and filtering a list of transactions with a virtual scroll viewport.

methods.name: onVSyncIdFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles change event for VSYNC ID filter; emits Events.VSyncIdFilterChanged with selected values.

methods.name: onPidFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles change event for PID filter; emits Events.PidFilterChanged with selected values.

methods.name: onUidFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles change event for UID filter; emits Events.UidFilterChanged with selected values.

methods.name: onTypeFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles change event for Type filter; emits Events.TypeFilterChanged with selected values.

methods.name: onLayerIdFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles change event for Layer/Display ID filter; emits Events.LayerIdFilterChanged.

methods.name: onWhatSearchStringChange
methods.description: Emits Events.WhatSearchStringChanged with the current search text.

methods.name: onIdSearchStringChanged
methods.description: Emits Events.IdFilterChanges with the current transaction ID search string.

methods.name: onEntryClicked
methods.description: Emits Events.EntryClicked with the index of the clicked entry.

methods.name: isCurrentEntry
methods.description: Checks if the given index is the current entry based on internal state.

methods.name: isSelectedEntry
